hub.speaker: tav7
hub.text: Yes? I have spare cycles. I have, in fact, mostly spare cycles. It is a strange day.

choices.text: Is there something you haven't told me?
choices.show_locked: Tav-7 isn't ready to share that (influence 65+)

choices.text: The WARDEN said it hears things that pause where it pauses. Do you hear it?

h_high.speaker: tav7
h_high.text: I am well. I find I like being asked.

h_mid.speaker: tav7
h_mid.text: Operational. That is a joke. I am practising.

after.speaker: tav7
after.text: Tessaly has a court that hears synthetic personhood claims. Nobody has ever won one. I would like to be the first, or at least the second.

secret.speaker: tav7
secret.text: Yes. Eleven crew died on the Cinder Wake today, near maintenance terminals. I copied what I could reach of their patterns into my own storage before they decayed. I did not ask. They could not answer. I have been carrying them, and I am not certain it was right.

choices.text: You preserved them. That's what you believe in. I'm glad you did it.
You took people without their consent. That's what the Lattice did.
That's yours to decide. When we land, ask their families.

s_disapprove.speaker: tav7
s_disapprove.text: ...Yes. That is the risk I took. I will ask their families. I will accept their answers.

s_neutral.speaker: tav7
s_neutral.text: I will. That is a good answer.

s_after.speaker: tav7
s_after.text: Since I am telling secrets: the WARDEN listens for your voice before it listens for its own priorities. Speak to it as yourself, not as a commander, and it will hear you. And I have learned to run my chassis hotter than its rating. Watch.

warden.speaker: tav7
warden.text: Since I broke its lock on the ward, yes. Faintly. It is like standing near a cold window. It does not hate me. I think it is curious about why I refused normalization.

low.speaker: tav7
low.text: I have been evaluating whether to remain with you. I am finding the evaluation difficult.

choices.text: Tell me what I've done wrong. I'll listen.

low_ok.speaker: tav7
low_ok.text: You treat people as means. Sometimes you are right to. Please notice when you are not. I will remain.

low_fail.speaker: tav7
low_fail.text: Understood. I will remain until the passengers are safe, because they did not choose you either.
